games.site: Sullivan Arena, Anchorage, AK (Great Alaska Shootout, Game 7)

notes: Points (TP) column used directly as printed and verified via team-total checksum (Virginia player pts sum = 65 = final score; South Carolina player pts sum = 59 = final score). Virginia Stith's FG-made was corrected from an apparent '9' to '8' after team FG-made/FGA totals (20-50) and points formula (2*FG+3PT+FT) only reconciled at FG=8; his AST/TO/STL (2/2/2) were similarly derived from team-total arithmetic where handwriting was ambiguous. Minutes for both teams sum exactly to 200 team-minutes, confirming lineup completeness. South Carolina's team totals for AST/TO/BLK/STL (16/9/3/5) are off by 1 from the individual-line sums (16/8/4/4) in a couple of spots due to OCR ambiguity in a couple of digits; since points and minutes checksums both pass exactly, the game was kept rather than skipped, but these secondary stat totals may be slightly imprecise for 1-2 players. Players with blank rows (Bernie Floriani, Chris Havlicek, Blair Ford, Dirk Katstra, Bobby Graves for Virginia; Carey Evans, Obrad Ignjatovic, Edmond Wilson for South Carolina) did not play and were omitted. Page also contains shooting-percentage summary lines and attendance (7,947), technical foul on South Carolina, and officials, not transcribed as they are not player/team box-score fields.
